source.title: DHL and Alibaba.com partner to bring AI-powered logistics capabilities to small and medium-sized enterprises worldwide
source.section: DHL and Alibaba.com partner to bring AI-powered logistics capabilities to small and medium-sized enterprises worldwide
source.type: DHL 与阿里巴巴国际站官方跨境贸易合作公告
source.context: DHL / Alibaba.com 官方业务材料；本课练习围绕实际业务沟通任务。
paragraphs: Bonn - DHL Group and Alibaba.com have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to pursue the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to improve the end-to-end logistics experience for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) engaged in international trade. The parties intend to evaluate how AI-powered tools can support customers throughout their international trade journey, from sourcing and supplier discovery to logistics quotation, booking and shipment execution to make cross-border trade simpler, faster and more accessible. The agreement was announced during Alibaba.com's CoCreate 2026 Conference in Los Angeles.

Katja Busch, Chief Commercial Officer DHL and Head of DHL Customer Solutions & Innovation, said: "SMEs are the backbone of the global economy, but many still face challenges navigating the complex rules, regulations, and trade requirements that come with international expansion. By bringing together Alibaba.com's digital commerce expertise and DHL's logistics capabilities, we want to explore how technology can help businesses spend less time managing complexity and more time focusing on growth."

DHL and Alibaba.com will explore the integration of DHL Global Forwarding's logistics services into Alibaba.com's agentic AI platform Accio. Accio is Alibaba.com's plug-and-play enterprise AI agent and agentic business team that equips businesses with an immediate, no-code taskforce designed to support the diverse operational needs of SMEs worldwide.

Through an agentic approach, Accio will be able to connect to DHL Global Forwarding's Quotation & Booking capabilities, enabling businesses to obtain real-time freight forwarding quotes, evaluate shipping options and book shipments more seamlessly. The new capability is the first in a planned suite of DHL logistics capabilities designed to automate key business tasks, improve operational efficiency and enable SMEs to scale more effectively.

Kuo Zhang, President of Alibaba.com, said: "AI is fundamentally changing how businesses participate in global trade, making capabilities that once required significant time, expertise and resources more accessible to small and medium-sized enterprises. At Alibaba.com, our vision for Accio is to help businesses move from opportunity to execution across the trade journey. By exploring ways to connect Accio with DHL's global logistics capabilities, we hope to lower the barriers to cross-border commerce and help SMEs move faster and with greater confidence as they grow internationally."

Tim Robertson, Executive Vice President Accelerated Digitalization, DHL Global Forwarding, said: "Global trade is becoming increasingly digital, and customers expect logistics to be as seamless as the rest of their business activities. Through this collaboration, we will explore how advanced AI capabilities can support customers with faster access to information, greater transparency and more efficient logistics processes. We see significant potential in combining intelligent digital platforms with DHL's logistics network and expertise."
translations: DHL 集团与 Alibaba.com 签署谅解备忘录，计划探索利用人工智能改善从事国际贸易的中小企业的端到端物流体验。双方将评估 AI 工具如何支持客户完成整个国际贸易流程：从采购和寻找供应商，到货运报价、订舱和货物运输，让跨境贸易更简单、更快捷、门槛更低。该协议在 Alibaba.com 于洛杉矶举办的 CoCreate 2026 大会上公布。
DHL 首席商务官兼客户解决方案与创新负责人 Katja Busch 表示：“中小企业是全球经济的支柱，但许多企业在国际扩张时，仍然难以应对复杂的规则、法规和贸易要求。通过结合 Alibaba.com 的数字商务专长与 DHL 的物流能力，我们希望探索技术如何帮助企业少花时间处理复杂事务，多花时间专注增长。”
DHL 与 Alibaba.com 将探索把 DHL Global Forwarding 的物流服务接入 Alibaba.com 的 AI 智能体平台 Accio。Accio 是 Alibaba.com 的即插即用企业 AI 智能体和智能业务团队，可为全球中小企业提供无需编程、可立即投入使用的任务支持。
通过智能体模式，Accio 将能够接入 DHL Global Forwarding 的报价与订舱能力，让企业获得实时货运代理报价、评估运输选项，并更顺畅地预订货运。这项新能力是 DHL 计划推出的一系列物流能力中的首项，旨在自动化关键业务任务、提升运营效率，并帮助中小企业更有效地扩大规模。
Alibaba.com 总裁 Kuo Zhang 表示：“AI 正在从根本上改变企业参与全球贸易的方式，让过去需要大量时间、专业知识和资源才能具备的能力，更容易被中小企业获得。我们对 Accio 的愿景，是帮助企业在整个贸易流程中从发现机会走到实际执行。通过探索 Accio 与 DHL 全球物流能力的连接方式，我们希望降低跨境贸易门槛，帮助中小企业更快、更有信心地拓展国际业务。”
DHL Global Forwarding 加速数字化执行副总裁 Tim Robertson 表示：“全球贸易日益数字化，客户也希望物流体验能像其他业务活动一样顺畅。通过此次合作，我们将探索先进 AI 能力如何帮助客户更快获取信息、提高透明度并提升物流效率。我们认为，将智能数字平台与 DHL 的物流网络和专业能力结合，潜力巨大。”

scenario.title: 模拟情境：跨境卖家需要切换多个平台
english: Small sellers use separate tools to find suppliers, request freight quotes, and book shipments.
A commerce platform and a logistics provider are discussing a possible integration, but the service has not launched.
Describe the workflow to test, identify what customers need, and define measures for a pilot.
chinese: 中小卖家需要使用不同工具寻找供应商、获取货运报价和预订运输。
电商平台和物流公司正在讨论可能的系统整合，但服务尚未上线。
请说明要测试的流程、确认客户需求，并提出试点指标。

firstAttempt.prompt: 跨境卖家要在多个平台寻找供应商、询价和订舱。请用英语提出一个连接这些环节的试点方案，并说明要核实什么。
firstAttempt.sample: We should explore a workflow that connects supplier discovery with logistics quotes and booking. The pilot should help sellers evaluate shipping options and book shipments in one place. Before expanding, we need to test quote accuracy, booking completion, time to shipment, and feedback from small businesses.
firstAttempt.rationale: 先说清平台连接的业务环节，再用试点指标检验报价、订舱速度和客户体验。

words.example: The platform helps buyers with supplier sourcing.
words.translation: 这个平台帮助买家寻找供应商。
words.note: 在跨境业务中常指寻找货源或供应商。

words.example: We requested a freight quote before confirming the order.
words.translation: 确认订单前，我们先申请了货运报价。
words.note: 报价常包含运输方式、费用和时效。

words.example: The seller booked the shipment after comparing options.
words.translation: 卖家比较方案后预订了货运。
words.note: 可指运输过程，也可指一批待运货物。

taskPhrases.word: connect supplier discovery with logistics booking
taskPhrases.meaning: 把供应商寻找与物流订舱连接起来
taskPhrases.example: The proposed integration would connect supplier discovery with logistics booking.
taskPhrases.translation: 拟议中的整合方案将连接供应商寻找与物流订舱。

taskPhrases.example: Buyers can evaluate shipping options before booking.
taskPhrases.translation: 买家可以在订舱前评估运输选项。

taskPhrases.word: test quote accuracy and booking completion
taskPhrases.meaning: 测试报价准确度和订舱完成率
taskPhrases.example: The pilot will test quote accuracy and booking completion.
taskPhrases.translation: 试点将测试报价准确度和订舱完成率。

structure.original: Through an agentic approach, Accio will be able to connect to DHL Global Forwarding's Quotation & Booking capabilities, enabling businesses to obtain real-time freight forwarding quotes, evaluate shipping options and book shipments more seamlessly.
analysis: enabling businesses to… 补充说明连接系统后企业可以完成的任务。
obtain、evaluate 和 book 是三个并列动作，顺序对应报价、比较和订舱。
the announcement says the teams will explore this capability; it is a planned integration.
structure.transfer: A shared portal connects product requests with supplier quotes, enabling buyers to compare offers and place orders in one workflow.

rewrite.bad: We will use AI to make all trade easy.
rewrite.good: We should explore a pilot that connects supplier discovery with logistics quotes and booking. Sellers could evaluate shipping options and book shipments in one place. We should measure quote accuracy, booking completion, and time to shipment before expanding the service.
rewrite.translation: 我们应该探索一个试点，把供应商寻找、物流报价和订舱连接起来。卖家可以在一个平台评估运输选项并预订货运。扩大服务前，我们要衡量报价准确度、订舱完成率和发货所需时间。
rewrite.pattern: We should explore a pilot that connects [step A] with [step B]. We should measure [accuracy / completion / time] before expanding.

cloze.prompt: We are exploring the use of AI to improve the logistics ______.
cloze.why: logistics experience 指客户使用物流服务的整体体验。

cloze.prompt: Buyers can ______ shipping options before booking.
cloze.why: evaluate options 表示比较并评估方案。

cloze.prompt: The pilot will test quote accuracy and booking ______.
cloze.why: booking completion 指订舱是否顺利完成。

choice.prompt: 合作双方正在讨论系统连接，但新服务还没有推出。对外介绍时，哪种说法准确？
options: The new service is already available to every small business.
The partners will explore connecting supplier discovery, freight quotes, and shipment booking.
The service has already reduced every seller’s delivery cost.
choice.why: The announcement says the partners will explore the integration; it does not say a pilot or service has launched.

output.prompt: 请向一位跨境卖家介绍双方正在探索的一站式流程，并说明哪些指标能判断这项合作方案是否值得进一步推进。
output.sample: The teams will explore a pilot that connects supplier discovery with freight quotes and booking. Sellers could compare shipping options and book a shipment in one place. We should track quote accuracy, booking completion, time to shipment, and seller feedback before expanding the service.
